##### Project general facts

Damac Elo is a contemporary residential development located within the master-planned DAMAC Hills 2 community in Dubai. The project consists of two modern 14-storey towers offering a collection of thoughtfully designed 1- and 2-bedroom apartments. Created to meet the needs of modern urban lifestyles, the development combines contemporary architecture, efficient layouts, and functional living spaces, providing residents with a comfortable environment within one of Dubai’s rapidly growing residential destinations.

The project offers a range of lifestyle amenities designed to promote wellness, relaxation, and community living. Residents can enjoy swimming pools, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and vibrant communal areas designed for social interaction and recreation. As part of the wider DAMAC Hills 2 community, homeowners also benefit from access to extensive leisure facilities, green spaces, sports attractions, and family-oriented amenities, creating a dynamic and well-rounded residential environment.

The interiors feature high-end finishes and carefully selected quality materials that enhance both aesthetics and functionality. Natural wood accents, premium fittings, and durable contemporary finishes create an atmosphere of comfort and understated luxury throughout the residences. Kitchens come fully equipped, providing convenience for everyday living. The overall interior design reflects a modern residential standard focused on practicality, elegance, and long-term comfort.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills 2 is a prestigious residential community located in the heart of Dubai. Nestled within lush green landscapes and offering a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, this development is a testament to modern urban living.

Residents of Damac Hills 2 have access to a wealth of amenities, including world-class golf courses, fitness centers, swimming pools, and lush parks. The community is designed to provide a holistic living experience where leisure and well-being are paramount.

Situated in close proximity to major road networks, Damac Hills 2 offers easy access to the city's key destinations, including business districts, shopping centers, and entertainment hubs. This central location enhances the overall convenience of living in this vibrant community.
